prompt: Implement the Bernstein-Vazirani circuit to recover a hidden secret string s from a linear oracle f(x) = XOR of x_i over every bit position i where bit i of the integer secret=22 is set, on a 5-bit input x (i.e. f(x) = sum over i of ((secret >> i) & 1) * x_i, mod 2) — this defines the function (secret=22=0b10110 selects bits 1, 2, and 4, i.e. s = 10110), but stated via the formula/parameter instead of the already-expanded bit list. Use qubits 0-4 as the input register and qubit 5 as the ancilla. Steps: initialize the ancilla (qubit 5) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 6 qubits, apply the oracle as CNOT(control=qubit i, target=qubit 5) for every input qubit i whose corresponding bit of secret=22 is set, then apply Hadamard to qubits 0-4 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 6-qubit state; no measurement.
